# Quality Checklist: AI Opportunity Board

**Purpose**: Validate the specification quality, clarity, and completeness for core logic, inputs, persistence, and sorting.
**Created**: 2026-08-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness & Clarity

- [x] CHK001 Are the requirements for the layout and user flow of the creation/edit states completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1 & 3]
- [x] CHK002 Is a requirement & acceptance criteria ID scheme fully established? [Traceability]
- [x] CHK003 Does the spec define whether duplicate process names are allowed or blocked? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]

## Score Rules & Calculations

- [x] CHK004 Are the formulas for `viabilidade` and `score` deterministic and free of vague instructions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Is the rounding method (nearest integer) mathematically specified for half-way decimal scores? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Are the reference test cases (Case 1, 2, and 3) fully verified to calculate deterministically to 100, 60, and 20? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 2]

## Input Limits & Validations

- [x] CHK007 Are the validation constraints for the name (1-80 chars, non-empty) and description (max 300 chars) testable and unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001 & FR-002]
- [x] CHK008 Is the validation behavior for out-of-range numeric inputs (not between 1 and 5) specified for boundaries? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK009 Is there a requirement specifying if name input text should be automatically trimmed before validation? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Persistence & Filters

- [x] CHK010 Is the browser storage mechanism (localStorage) key and format explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK011 Does the spec define the initial state of the application when localStorage is empty? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK012 Is the cumulative behavior (AND logic) of Area and Priority filters clearly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007b]

## Sorting & Acceptance Criteria

- [x] CHK013 Is the sorting order (highest to lowest score) clearly specified with a deterministic tie-breaker for identical scores? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK014 Are the acceptance criteria for each user story objectively testable? [Measurability, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [x] CHK015 Does the spec define how the summary metrics change when active filters result in an empty list? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
